_comment: Copy to seed.json and point LOCALIO_SEED at it. Applied on every boot, upserting —
accounts keyed by sid, numbers by the number — so it is safe to check in and safe to
run twice. Pin account_sid and auth_token to whatever your application already has in
its own configuration, and this simulator will answer to it.
A number with no account_sid joins the first account in this file.
parent_account_sid makes an account a subaccount. Either order works — the parent may
be listed after the child — and the parent's credentials open the child over REST.
A messaging_services entry is a pool: a message sent with its sid and no From goes out
from a random number in phone_numbers, and inbound_request_url answers for every one
of them instead of each number's own sms_url. The pool is declarative — the list here
is what it becomes — and services are keyed by sid, or by friendly_name if none is set.
